registration_scope: Targeted follow-up registered after the row audit discovered repeated exposure records and checked published accepted masks, but before inspecting any nominal-versus-deduplicated fit result. Not an externally timestamped registration.
known_before_registration: 94 raw duplicate MJD-band groups have multiple published accepted rows; 374 published accepted records correspond to 376 raw records in those groups. Preliminary records share IMGNUM and calibrated flux, with occasionally differing flux errors.
baseline_gate: Do not interpret or run scientific nominal-versus-deduplicated fits until official reproduction agent/root approves common baseline configuration after resolving historical epoch selection and model/calibration differences.
audit_before_mutation: Compare CCDNUM, FIELD, PHOTFLAG, PHOTPROB, FLUXCAL, FLUXCALERR, PSF_SIG1/2/RATIO, SKY_SIG/T, RDNOISE, ZEROPT/ERR, GAIN, XPIX,YPIX and all actual PHOT fields within each group. Positive image IDs required. Different exposures or detector coordinates must not be merged solely because dates match.

arms.name: nominal
arms.data: All original rows and same baseline configuration.

arms.name: first_record
arms.data: For verified same-exposure groups with identical calibrated flux and detector identity, retain smallest original PHOT row; preserve that row's flux and uncertainty. Keep every unrelated row and delimiter. This is a dependence sensitivity, not a claim of author-intended correction.

arms.name: maximum_error_record
arms.data: For same-exposure groups whose only scientific disagreement is uncertainty, retain row with maximum FLUXCALERR, breaking ties by original row. This brackets the arbitrary first-record choice without claiming exact missing exposure covariance.

execution: Rebuild derived FITS pointer MIN/MAX and NOBS consistently. Originals immutable; record membership mapping and SHA256 for inputs, derived tables, executable and config. Refit all affected published DES objects with the same software/model/cuts, retaining unsuccessful fits in the denominator.
outcomes: paired changes in mB,x1,c,t0 and full fit covariance
paired standardized mB+alpha*x1-beta*c changes only for declared alpha,beta
maximum absolute shift and full affected/unaffected denominator
decision_rule: No significance threshold or exclusion tuned to cosmology. Report exact outputs including negligible or contradictory effects. Cosmology-level conclusion requires propagation through selection, bias correction and shared covariance; this sensitivity alone cannot establish a bias in acceleration.
independence: Shared same-exposure fluxes cannot gain independent measurement information merely by repeating rows; full correlation is the limiting dependence alternative, not an empirically measured covariance. If source semantics reveal distinct independent measurements, do not deduplicate those groups.
